definitions.name: Equal-interval mean wholesale price
definitions.population: Published regional reference prices for all 288 five-minute TRADE intervals in one completed fixed-AEST calendar day
definitions.adjustment: Nominal wholesale prices; no seasonal or inflation adjustment
definitions.period_convention: YYYY-MM-DD calendar day in fixed AEST UTC+10; interval endings 00:05 through next 00:00
definitions.cadence: completed calendar day; monthly-file update timing is not established
definitions.rounding: Exact integer-cent sum / 288, rounded to two AUD/MWh decimals, half away from zero
definitions.revision_policy: Mutable monthly publisher files; finality and correction schedule not established
definitions.licence: AEMO copyright permissions; accurate attribution required
definitions.limitations: Two NEM regions only; no Australian average, retail bill, forecast or moving 24-hour window. Prices are the published rounded TRADE values, not a claim of finality. Monthly files may be revised. Zero after cent rounding does not establish an exactly zero higher-precision dispatch price. Equal-interval mean is not demand-weighted.
